The score's tied at 239 a piece heading into the 10th overtime in game 7 at the animated arena. A prominent player has 200 points, a teammate with 30, another with 5, and a fourth player was fouled twice for 4 points. On the opposing team, their star player has 179, another teammate has 30, a third has 10, a fourth has 2, and a fifth has 8. The leading player is completely exhausted, scoring most of his team's points by playing every single minute of the game, trying to beat a legendary record as well as outdo the opposing star. The opposing player, however, is tired but fine; and is capable of taking control of this game. As the buzzer sounded and 5 more minutes were added to the clock, a teammate suggests the leading player should take a break. He shouts, but agrees- and in comes another player. In 1 minute, the opposing player scores 15 points and 5 assists to his teammates, as well as 1 to a wide open player. The leading player looks up at the scoreboard in disgust, and a gleam out of the corner of his eye catches his gaze- a famous actor drinking out of a white water bottle. Some purple tape and black text written in hasty sharpie appear on the other side of the bottle, and the actor stops drinking and sets it down. The leading player screams "timeout!" And the game stops with exactly 3:30 left. "Yo, come here" a small bird comes over to him as he whispers in her ear. She nods, then flies off in the direction of the opposing team's bench. As a teammate tries to draw up a strategy, the leading player can only stare at the bird struggle to carry the bottle, his gaze never leaving. She finally returns with the bottle exhausted, and he takes it back to the bench. "Secret Stuff" the bottle reads, and when nobody is looking, he crosses out the name and writes his own. He takes a sip, and immediately downs the whole bottle after realizing its power. The buzzer sounds, and he is to guard the opposing star. "Time to change eras, old man." Says the opposing player. "Man, shut your mouth." Says the leading player, who pushes off the opposing player to catch a pass from his teammate. He screams as he runs over the opposing star, tramples another player, steps on a third, then finally uses the actor as a launchpad to soar 40 feet in the air for the dunk. All of the animated characters' jaws drop, and he shrugs. As the game progresses, there is no stopping him; but the opposing player is persistent. With 30 seconds to go, the leading player trails by 5; another timeout is called. He heads back to the bottle to find it's empty, and he immediately goes to the referee to complain. The referee gives him a warning after 25 threats from him, and the game continues. In the huddle, he gives his team commands. "Okay: cut to the basket. Bird, set some screens. Big Chicken thing, fly around and check some people." The opposing player gathers his team. "Okay guys, ughh, have fun out there." He gets the ball from a pass. As the leading player charges towards him with a full head of steam along with a teammate, the opposing player throws a 3-point alley-oop to the actor. Down by only 2 now, the leading player takes up the ball. Dribbling around for 20 seconds, the opposing team is now on him but he refuses to pass it. Finally, with nobody open, he shoots it; and watches as the clock goes down to 0.0: the ball still soaring through the air. "Yes! All hail the King baby!" He shouts. "Suck it!" He stops talking as the ball hits back iron and soars back across the entire court- and into the other basket. The opposing team can't believe it, and the crowd goes nuts. He bows his head into defeat as he goes into the press conference sporting an all-black outfit. "Who is most accountable for the loss today?" Asks a reporter, eager to hassle him. "I found that the officiating wasn't really up to par, and my teammates are just animated characters. Also my coach doesn't know much, and I play for quite possibly the worst team in the league; I mean I carried us here. I am the only reason we're here." He pauses for a moment and looks down at his microphone. "But we play as a team, and we're all to blame really... We win together, and we lose together. As the press conference starts to end, he reveals he is taking his talents to a fictional town.
